versions.content: Service Name Nv M_ Init Block Callback Function Syntax Std_ Return Type Nv M_ Init Block Callback Function ( Nv M_ Init Block Request Type Init Block Request ) Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant Parameters (in) Init Block Request The request type (read, restore, ... etc.) of the currently processed block Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Return Type E_ OK: callback function has been processed successfully any other: callback function has been processed unsuccessfully Description Per block callback routine which shall be called by the Nv M module when default data needs to be restored in RAM, eve n if a ROM block is configured. Note: Here the application should copy default data to a RAM block if a ROM block isn't configured and/ or it could set some flags to know that default data was restored. Available via Nv M_ Externals.h
